This land is rented, so I am not going to pour my small savings into chemical fertilizer that the landlord will benefit from if he does not renew the lease. I will work this plot with my own hands and the help of my family, mixing in whatever poultry manure I can gather to give the tubers some strength. The rains here in the southwest have always been enough for root crops, and I will pull the weeds myself rather than spend money on sprays. If the harvest is big, I might pay a few young men for a day or two to help me dig, but otherwise we will manage alone.
